name: Cabin Experience Page
description: A cabin page: hero, feature cards, specs table and a CTA band, for First, Business, Premium Economy and Economy.

evidence: Structure and accent rules only; the specs table and CTA band are not specified.

provenance.tag: Four cabins: Official. Premium accents: A · unverified. Premium Economy / Economy accents: Rec.

structure:
[Hero: cabin photography + display-lg title]
[Feature row: CabinFeatureCard ×3–4 (icon --icon-size-lg + heading-3 + body-sm)]
[Specs table: seat pitch, width, screen]
[CTA band]
rules: Four cabins (Official): First, Business, Premium Economy, Economy. File A lists only three.

First Class pages may use --color-border-premium and gold fills (A · unverified). Business uses --color-border-premium-strong (bronze, A · unverified). Premium Economy and Economy use the standard red system (Rec; no source for Premium Economy).
Full cabin theming (including File A's First Class dark mode) is out of scope.
